steps.boxTitle: What will the box be like?
steps.driverIntro: Look for your driver in the catalog. If it is not there, bring the data from the manual with AI or type it in. To continue we only need Fs, Qts and Vas.
steps.boxIntro: Answer a few questions. The box is drawn alongside and the numbers update right away.
steps.reviewIntro: Here is everything that was filled in. Check it against the manual before cutting wood; when you finish, the project stays in the workbench.

blocked.driver: Fs, Qts or Vas is missing.
blocked.box: Enter the box size (and the tuning, for a vented box) to continue.
blocked.find: Pick a driver from the catalog or another way to fill in.
blocked.missing_one: Just 1 value missing to continue. Tap it to go to the field:
blocked.missing_other: {{count}} values missing to continue. Tap one to go to the field:

driver.typingHint: Type the values below. Fs, Qts and Vas are enough to simulate; Re, Sd, Xmax and Pe complete impedance, excursion and power.
driver.ready: All set: it can be simulated. Check the values and fill in what you have.
driver.minimumNote: Values calculated from the others appear in grey and can be replaced.

catalog.offline: Offline: the catalog needs the server. You can still type the data in.
catalog.applyError: Could not copy this driver. Try again.
catalog.empty: Nothing found. Try another term or use one of the other options to bring the data.

ai.filledNone: The AI found no valid parameter.
ai.suspect: Check: {{fields}} do not match the others.
ai.multiple: The text seems to describe more than one driver; we used the first.
ai.review: The data read replaces the previous driver's. Check every value against the datasheet.
ai.offline: Offline: AI reading needs the server.
ai.unavailable: AI reading is unavailable right now. You can still type the data in.

pdf.intro: Attach the manual or datasheet as a PDF. The AI finds the parameters and fills in the fields.
pdf.notPdf: The file must be a PDF.
pdf.tooLarge: The PDF is larger than 10 MB.
pdf.drop: Drag the PDF here or choose the file: reading starts on its own
pdf.hint: PDF up to 10 MB and 30 pages
pdf.privacy: Only the PDF text goes to an external AI service. The file is not stored.
pdf.reading: The AI is reading the manual…

text.intro: Paste the text with the parameters (from a store, the manual, a message). Only lines with values, like "Fs 35 Hz", are sent to AI.
text.label: Text with the parameters
text.placeholder:
Brand Model 12"
Fs 35 Hz
Qts 0.45
Vas 60 L
Re 3.4 Ω
text.filterNone: No line with a parameter found (e.g. "Fs 35 Hz").
text.filter_one: {{count}} line with a parameter will be sent; {{dropped}} ignored.
text.filter_other: {{count}} lines with parameters will be sent; {{dropped}} ignored.
text.privacy: Only the lines with parameters go to an external AI service. Nothing is stored.

sourceHints.pdf: Attach the manual or datasheet. AI reads the parameters for you.
sourceHints.text: Paste the text from a store or the manual. AI picks out the values.
sourceHints.typing: Type Fs, Qts and Vas (and anything else you have) straight into the fields.

driver.sourceLocked: Needs a connection to the server.
driver.cameFrom: Data from: {{source}}. Check it and fill in what is missing.
driver.findHint: Search by brand, model or size. The parameters come filled in.

box.bandpass: The assistant works with sealed or vented boxes. Bandpass is still available in the workbench.

type.title: What type of box?
type.closedHint: Closed, more compact, with tight and controlled bass. Good for beginners.
type.ventedHint: With a port: deeper bass and more output for the same power, in a bigger box.

count.title: How many drivers go in the box?

size.title: How big is the box?
size.needed: Enter the volume or the size to see the response.
size.externalHint: Outside measurements, including the wood. The internal volume comes from them minus the thickness.
size.invalid: With these sizes the box does not close. The value was not applied; check the sizes and the thickness.
size.tooSmall: The outer {{axis}} must be more than {{min}} (two board thicknesses). The value was not applied; increase it or reduce the thickness.

box.classicApplied: Volume and tuning from the classic alignment for this driver. Adjust as you like.

classicFail.useClosed: This driver calls for a sealed box: its Qts is high for a vented one.
classicFail.qtsTooHigh: This driver's Qts is too high for a classic suggestion.
classicFail.qtsTooLow: This driver's Qts is too low for a classic suggestion.
classicFail.missing: Fs, Qts or Vas is missing to suggest.
classicFail.portTooLarge: The port is too large for the suggested box. Reduce the port diameter.

tuning.title: What frequency to tune to?
tuning.hint: The tuning (Fb) sets how deep the bass goes. The port length is calculated from it.

power.title: How powerful is the amplifier?
power.hint: RMS power per driver. Used to check excursion and port air speed.

port.title: What will the port be like?
port.hint: Round (PVC tube), rectangular (made from board, slot style) or triangular (in the corners). A wider port blows less air; the length comes from the tuning.
port.triangleHint: Triangular: boards across the box corners form the port (up to 4, one per corner). Position and mounting can be adjusted in the workbench.

ai.title: Want help from the AI?
ai.button: Ask the AI for a box suggestion
ai.hint: Describe the use (car, home, music style) and the AI proposes up to three boxes, each checked by the simulator before it shows up.
ai.offline: Offline: the AI suggestion needs the server.

review.check: Check each value against the driver manual before cutting. The assistant calculates from what was entered.
review.name: Model
